parameter_notes.storage_penalty_weight: At 50% storage ratio (max allowed), penalizes score by 0.3. Chosen so that moderate storage use is acceptable but excessive indexing is discouraged.
parameter_notes.count_penalty_weight: At max 10 indexes, penalizes score by 0.1. Lower than storage_penalty to prioritize storage cost over index count.
parameter_notes.numeric_tolerance: Standard floating-point tolerance for result correctness comparison.

parameter_notes.query_repeats: Median of 3 runs reduces timing noise without excessive wall-clock cost.
parameter_notes.warmup_rounds: 2 warmup rounds stabilize buffer pool and query planning before measurement.
parameter_notes.single_threaded: SET max_parallel_workers_per_gather = 0 ensures reproducible single-threaded timing.
